summary: The general adjointness of Hecke polynomials for an invariant pairing, applied to innerAt σ.

steps.claim: innerAt σ is (a multiple of) the smooth pairing of the smooth forms, which is invariant under right translation (smoothPairing_formTranslation); both forms are spherical at w and w̄ since w, w̄ lie off the places of O and their conjugates (mem_sphericalAt, hS); so heckePolyOp_adjoint at the split place w gives the adjoint H_{w̄}(σ⁻¹(conj σX)) of H_w(X).
steps.lean:
simpa [innerAt] using! heckePolyOp_adjoint hw _ (mem_sphericalAt _ hS) (mem_sphericalAt _ hS)
    (smoothPairing_formTranslation _) _
